name: order-management
description: ODACC/DOPID perspective for the OCEL 2.0 order-management log. Shared products, customers and employees are kept out of the conformance perspective to avoid global components; ORDER/ITEM/PACKAGE retain the object-centric package-merging behavior.
notes: The CPN probabilistic guards fbool(...) are simulation-routing choices and are intentionally not translated to conformance guards.
The CPN package weight is computed by fweights(its); the DOPID therefore checks package weight against the sum of the selected item weights.
The OCEL generator has order.price = sum(item.price) + 5.0, so the pay-order guard is a meaningful late data-consistency check.

Product, customer and employee objects are contextual/global resources. Excluding them from the conformance perspective prevents unrelated orders from becoming one giant component merely because they share a product or employee.
